question: Can an optimizer that generalises from small proxy tasks to state-of-the-art training be discovered automatically by searching a space of programs?
hypothesis: Searching programs with evolution plus selection on larger meta-validation tasks and simplification yields an optimizer that generalises beyond the proxy tasks and beats AdamW/Adafactor.
contributions: A method that formulates algorithm discovery as program search with warm-start/restart evolution, abstract execution, funnel selection and simplification
Lion (EvoLved Sign Momentum), memory-efficient and with uniform per-parameter update magnitude
Evaluation across image classification, vision-language, diffusion, language modeling and fine-tuning, plus analysis of limits

method.summary: Evolutionary program search (regularized evolution with warm start from AdamW, restarts, abstract-execution pruning and caching, funnel selection on larger meta-validation tasks, manual simplification) over a 43-45 function imperative language produces the optimizer Lion (sign of an interpolated momentum, momentum-only state). Lion is then compared against AdamW/Adafactor (and others) across image classification, contrastive vision-language, diffusion, language modeling and T5 fine-tuning, each optimizer tuned for lr and weight decay.
method.task: optimizer discovery by program search; evaluation on neural-network training

datasets.name: ImageNet (ReaL, V2, A, R, Sketch, ObjectNet)
datasets.split: from scratch: ResNet-50 90 epochs batch 1,024, others 300 epochs batch 4,096
datasets.preprocessing: image size 224 by default; RandAug 2,15 and Mixup 0.5/0.8 in some runs (Table 12)

datasets.name: ImageNet-21K
datasets.split: 90 epochs, batch 4,096, then fine-tune on ImageNet

datasets.name: JFT-300M and JFT-3B (JFT-5B for BASIC)
datasets.split: ViT-B/L/H on JFT-300M, ViT-g/G on JFT-3B; 7 or 14 epochs (517,791 / 1,035,583 steps) per Table 8

datasets.name: LM1B / 10% ImageNet proxies
datasets.preprocessing: ViT proxy: 64x64 images, patch 16; LM proxy: sequence length 32, vocab 3K

datasets.name: Internal GLaM-like corpus
datasets.source: internal, similar to GLaM (Du et al. 2022)

datasets.name: Internal image-text dataset, MSCOCO, Flickr30K
datasets.split: 2K MSCOCO val images for real-time Imagen eval

models.name: AdamW / Adafactor / SGD momentum / RAdam / NAdam / AdaBelief / AMSGrad / PowerSign / AddSign
Vision models: ResNet-50, Mixer-S/B, ViT-S/B/L/H/g/G, CoAtNet-1/3/7, LiT, BASIC-L, U-Net diffusion, Imagen, T5 Base/Large/11B
models.init_from: LiT: frozen pre-trained ViT image encoder

training.objective: supervised classification / contrastive / diffusion / LM / masked LM / GLUE fine-tuning per task; the search itself maximises proxy validation accuracy or perplexity
training.optimizer: Lion vs AdamW/Adafactor; evolutionary search: regularized evolution, population 1K, tournament size 2
training.lr: per task, Table 12 (e.g. ViT-B/16 Lion 1e-3 vs AdamW 3e-3; with strong aug Lion 1e-4 vs AdamW 1e-3; diffusion Lion 3e-5 vs 3e-4; 7.5B LM Lion 1e-4 vs Adafactor 1e-3; T5 fine-tune Lion 3e-6 vs AdamW 3e-5)
training.lr_schedule: default cosine decay; linear decay for LM; constant for diffusion and T5 fine-tuning
training.batch_size: ResNet-50 1,024; other from-scratch vision 4,096; ImageNet-21K 4,096; LiT 16,384; BASIC 65,536; diffusion 2,048; LM 2^18 tokens (small-scale), 3M tokens (large); T5 fine-tune 128; proxy 64
training.steps: LM small-scale 125K; T5 fine-tune 500K; proxies 30K (vision) / 20K (LM); JFT per Table 8
training.epochs: ResNet-50 90; others from scratch 300; ImageNet-21K 90; JFT 7 or 14
training.precision: momentum stored as bfloat16 by default
training.weight_decay: decoupled, per task Table 12 (Lion values 3-10x AdamW)
training.regularisation: stochastic depth 0.1-0.7, RandAug 2,15, Mixup 0.5/0.8 per Table 12
training.hardware: search: 100 TPU V2 chips per run; target tasks up to 512 TPU V4 chips; ViT-B/16 memory example 8 vs 16 TPU V4 chips
training.compute: ~3K TPU V2 days for search; ~72h per search run
training.wall_clock: proxy eval <20 min on one TPU V2 chip; ~72h per search
training.seeds: Table 2 averaged over three runs; five search runs for Fig 2; other tables not stated

other.adamw_defaults: beta1 0.9, beta2 0.999, eps 1e-8; eps 1e-6 and beta2 0.99 for language tasks
other.tuning: peak lr and lambda tuned on log scale for both Lion and baseline; Sec 4.4 also tunes beta1/beta2
other.search_space: 43 functions listed in App H (Sec 2.1 says 45); program mutations insert/delete/modify; constants mutated by factor 2^a, a~N(0,1)

inference.decoding: diffusion: DDPM 1K sampling steps, no classifier-free guidance for ImageNet; Imagen eval uses guidance weight 5.0
inference.samples: not stated except three runs for Table 2

metrics.name: top-1 accuracy
metrics.definition: ImageNet, ReaL, V2, A, R, Sketch, ObjectNet; zero-shot for LiT/BASIC

metrics.name: FID
metrics.definition: ImageNet generation; zero-shot FID-30K on MSCOCO for Imagen

metrics.name: Recall@K
metrics.definition: ground-truth label of query appears in top-K retrieved

eval.protocol: Every optimizer tuned for lr and weight decay; Table 2 averaged over three runs; no significance tests reported; Lion's lack of significance acknowledged in limitations

limits: Search space is biased toward first-order optimizers; no second-order functions; search cost large and simplification manual (Sec 6)
Evaluation limited to chosen tasks; ResNet gaps are small; gain falls with strong augmentation (Sec 6)
Lion ties AdamW on Imagen base model, large-scale LM perplexity and C4 masked LM; difference not statistically significant on some large language and image-text datasets (Sec 1, 6)
Likely no better than AdamW below batch size 64 (Sec 6)
Still needs bfloat16 momentum, expensive for giant models
Seeds and variance are not reported outside Table 2 (three runs); no significance tests
Baselines are tuned by the authors; Imagen base width reduced to 192 for compute
Hyperparameters for language tasks tune beta1/beta2 (and AdamW eps) separately from the vision defaults

terms.definition: EvoLved Sign Momentum: tracks only momentum and takes the sign of an interpolation of gradient and momentum to compute the update
